assets.verifiedBehavior: Original UI controls performed six backend mutations: manual job creation, application creation, document attachment, stage change, note creation and reminder creation. Every mutation returned 200 after the original trailing-slash redirects. Application state, note, PDF attachment and reminder were reloaded successfully in a fresh authenticated context. No browser page errors were recorded.

caveats: The original frontend was built and run from an isolated archive of the recorded revision; its presentation and product behavior were not edited. The backend reused installed dependencies from a cached image, with the archived current source mounted over /app.

A fresh database exposed an incomplete migration baseline. The isolated setup added the missing users.totp_secret column before the existing widening migration and supplied users.totp_enabled and users.backup_codes to match the current ORM. All fifteen existing migrations then reached head. These setup repairs are not changes to the original checkout.

Historical workspace data and the verified Pro account were seeded directly into the isolated database. The new Lattice Studio job, application, resume attachment, stage update, note and reminder were created through the original UI. The Pro flag demonstrates available UI, not a verified payment flow.

Paid AI, Google OAuth/Calendar, outbound email and background workers were disabled or absent. Their visible controls were not exercised. The backend was isolated on an internal Docker network; the only browser-facing gateway and frontend were bound to loopback.

The original dashboard has status-mapping and weekly-metric inconsistencies, so it is omitted. Mixed historical status labels can appear as separate summary chips even when the Kanban column combines them; the original UI was preserved.

The film contains real lossless Chromium compositor frames, trimmed before setup, slowed to 62.5% playback for reading, and encoded once to H.264. The dark chapter band is editorial; the application pixels were not recreated.
